independence_statement: This is a new nonlinear derivative-clock candidate. It does not reopen or tune the branch-baker candidate and consumes no sealed prime, zero, or prior experiment result.
research_question: Can the genuine nonlinear derivative clock of the frozen PCF quadratic have a finite periodic orbit whose raw multiplier is rational and has rational-prime absolute value?

parameter.provenance: Inherited exactly from the already frozen postcritically finite relation; not selected by multiplier, prime, zeta-zero, or spectral fitting.

maps.multiplier_invariance: exact periods and cycle multipliers agree under phi

definitions.cycle_multiplier: lambda=(g^n)'(z) for a point z of exact period n
definitions.raw_rational_prime_target: lambda in Q and abs(lambda)=p for a positive rational prime p
definitions.rational_exponent_prime_target: lambda in Q and abs(lambda)=p^n for a positive rational prime p and exact period n
definitions.complex_modulus_only_target: abs(lambda)=p^n without lambda in Q; explicitly outside the theorem

primary_claims: C1: If K is a number field, F in O_K[X] is monic, and F'=m*H with integer m>=2 and H in O_K[X], then every rational multiplier at a finite point fixed by F^n lies in m^n*Z.
C2: For g(z)=z^2-u, every rational period-n multiplier lies in 2^n*Z.
C3: The frozen g and f_u have no raw rational-prime multiplier at any exact period.
C4: A rational exponent-prime multiplier must use p=2; odd p is excluded, while p=2 for n>=2 remains open.
C5: On each regular real branch, the cotangent formula (q,p)->(g(q),p/g'(q)) is exact symplectic and gives return eigenvalues lambda and lambda^-1 along the zero section.

predeclared_exact_predictions.general_divisibility: lambda in Q implies lambda in m^n*Z
predeclared_exact_predictions.candidate_divisibility: lambda in Q implies lambda in 2^n*Z
predeclared_exact_predictions.fixed_multiplier_plus_2_condition: would force u=0, contradicted by P(0)=-2
predeclared_exact_predictions.fixed_multiplier_minus_2_condition: would force u=2, contradicted by P(2)=2

exact_low_period_audit.cycle_polynomial_rule: verify exactly that the monic resultant is an n-th power after accounting for formal-period degeneracies; define the monic cycle multiplier polynomial only after that verification
exact_low_period_audit.rational_candidate_rule: detect rational roots exactly by reducing every coefficient to the basis 1,u,u^2 and solving the simultaneous rational polynomial conditions; numerical near-integers are never candidates
exact_low_period_audit.exact_period_rule: separate exact-period cycles from formal dynatomic roots; any root-of-unity lower-period contamination is recorded rather than silently counted
exact_low_period_audit.primality_rule: apply deterministic primality testing only to exact rational integers derived internally as multiplier candidates
independent_checks: direct chain-rule multiplier in the quotient algebra for every dynatomic factor
same multiplier polynomial from f_u and g after exact conjugacy normalization

stop_rules: Any failure of the algebraic parameter identity, conjugacy, or Theorem A implementation is an implementation stop.
A low-period result inconsistent with 2^n divisibility is a code/algebra error and may not be reinterpreted as a discovery.
A formal dynatomic root is not called exact period n until lower-period contamination is excluded.
The p=2 exponent-prime residue remains OPEN unless a separate all-period proof is completed; finite cutoff absence cannot close it.
If the non-Arb certification gate for the real ledger fails, the ledger is omitted rather than weakened to floating evidence.
The cotangent bridge does not open global symplectic, compactness, quantization, prime/zero, or Route-B claims.
After the raw-prime obstruction is verified, no prime or zero matching stage is opened for this candidate.
